claim_scope: Sharp universal spectral Schur multiplier norm of two-level complex symbols \(aJ+bB\), over all finite widths and binary \(v\)-row matrices \(B\) with constant column weight \(k\).
integrity: Analytical two-sided proof; numerical verifier corroborates finite instances only. No independent verification or scholarly priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The extremum is over all column counts; not every individual incidence matrix attains the stated value.
The equality supports are not classified, although complete k-uniform and suitable block-design systems attain the bound.
No claim concerns mixed column weights or Schatten-p multiplier norms away from spectral endpoints.
An equivalent prior parametrized extremal formula under different terminology is not completely ruled out.
title: Sharp column-weight extremal Schur multiplier norms
